body.label: Target
body.html: One visible space within 2 units; yourself or a willing ally adjacent to it.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Mark the space as a rally point until the start of your next turn. The chosen creature gains +1 Fortitude against the next attack targeting it while within 1 unit of the point.

surges.html: Move the point 1 unit before establishing it.
One willing creature within 1 unit of the point becomes Rallied until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Authority - Standard
rider.html: Spend this Authority when a willing creature within 1 unit of the marked point is missed: it may move 1 unit toward the point without triggering movement Reactions.
